request_fields: task prompt (paper Table 8: plain-language discharge instructions, 3 components) + discharge_summary
notes: Benchmark exists only as part of the ClinicBench release (Liu et al., EMNLP 2024; ClinicBench is the suite and the own release). Prompt text per task is in Table 8 of the paper (https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.759.pdf); the release ships items without the prompt. Released file has 3621 rows, but the paper (Table 1) reports 181 evaluation items; the 181-item test subset is not identifiable in the release (no split column; first column is all 0). Items are MIMIC-III discharge summaries (lower-cased, [name] placeholders) redistributed on GitHub; public=yes on the criterion as written, but this is outside the PhysioNet DUA; flag for a decision. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.
